scenarios.name: Notes:ConversationAndEventTimeFiltersApplyBeforeJoin
scenarios.expected_behavior: Conversation and event start bounds both apply; starts are inclusive, ends exclusive; empty conversation agents do not join.

scenarios.name: Notes:InlineAndExternalUserFilters
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only selected user contributes for both inline lists and external tables.

scenarios.name: Notes:MetadataLatestIncludeAndExclude
scenarios.expected_behavior: Latest metadata value wins. Include-only selects two matching conversations; include+exclude and exclude-only preserve zero aggregates in the test environment.

scenarios.name: Notes:NoMatchingDataAndNoEventConversation
scenarios.expected_behavior: No-event conversations do not contribute. Ungrouped query retains a zero row and grouped query returns empty response.

scenarios.name: Notes:SameConversationMultipleAgentsGroupedAndOverall
scenarios.expected_behavior: A shared key counts once overall, once per grouped agent; global denominator is one conversation/two users and grouped totals sum two conversations.

scenarios.name: Notes:TimeBoundsAndTimezoneGrouping
scenarios.expected_behavior: Time bounds retain two events in separate Honolulu day buckets; frequency user denominator is summed across buckets; user fields are enriched.

scenarios.name: GuidedWorkflow:GroupingByDocumentCountsSessionWithinEachDocument

transient_extraction_issue.observed: Wildcard right-table projection exported qualified conversation_id, causing missing-column errors in frozen readers. Explicit qualified right-key alias also failed in a minimal query.
transient_extraction_issue.repair: Project merged unqualified columns with explicit stable AS aliases. Minimal query and final full frozen suites verify repair.
